text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
At the Osaka Hai, Duramente was certain 
she would grasp something in today's race.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Something she needs in order to shoulder it all 
and become the best in the world--

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
The key to it is likely Kitasan Black. 
The two faced off in the paddock, sparks flying 
between them, neither willing to lose.
